name: Enterprise Digital Maturity Framework
source_note: Anonymized demonstration framework derived from prior assessment methodology; no organization identifiers retained.

criteria.title: Architecture Governance
criteria.question: Is enterprise architecture governed through defined roles, decision rights, standards and review mechanisms?

criteria.title: Strategy Alignment
criteria.question: Are architecture decisions demonstrably aligned with enterprise strategy and transformation priorities?

criteria.title: Stakeholder Engagement
criteria.question: Are business and technology stakeholders systematically involved in architecture decisions?

criteria.title: Architecture Repository
criteria.question: Are architecture artifacts organized, current, controlled and reusable?

criteria.title: Infrastructure Governance
criteria.question: Are infrastructure standards, ownership and lifecycle controls formally defined?

criteria.title: Availability & Resilience
criteria.question: Is resilience supported by documented continuity, redundancy, monitoring and recovery evidence?

criteria.title: Asset & Configuration Management
criteria.question: Are technology assets and configurations inventoried, owned and maintained?

criteria.title: Service Governance
criteria.question: Are digital services managed through defined ownership, lifecycle and performance controls?

criteria.title: User-Centric Design
criteria.question: Is user research and service feedback evidenced in service design and improvement?

criteria.title: Service Measurement
criteria.question: Are service performance and quality monitored using defined indicators?

criteria.title: Security Governance
criteria.question: Are information-security roles, policies, risk processes and governance mechanisms documented?

criteria.title: Technical Controls
criteria.question: Are security controls evidenced across networks, endpoints, servers and applications?

criteria.title: Vulnerability & Threat Management
criteria.question: Are vulnerabilities and threats identified, prioritized, remediated and monitored?

criteria.title: Continuous Improvement
criteria.question: Are security assessments, audits and remediation activities repeated and governed?
